purpose: Reduce the Pandora209 metadata blocker to facts that are actually instrument/file specific by freezing the generic PGN Level-1 GEOMS field semantics already documented publicly, without opening selected target radiance arrays.

source.title: DIVA2 Demonstration of an Integrated approach - Level 1 GEOMS format
source.role: official/public PGN-format documentation; generic field semantics only, not proof of Pandora209 calibration validity in 2026

FILTERWHEEL.ONE.meaning: filterwheel position 1; interpretation requires the instrument operation file

FILTERWHEEL.TWO.meaning: filterwheel position 2; interpretation requires the instrument operation file

LEVEL1.DATA.reason: the selected sky-radiance values are protected validation outcomes even though the field name and units semantics are public metadata

LEVEL1.UNCERTAINTY.documentedMeaning: measurement uncertainty derived from the number of measurement cycles within one measurement routine
